back.es: English (adjective: from England, or relating to the English language); feminine inglesa
back.example: My friend (female) is English, from London.

note: Since this is the word's only card, the editor could mention in the grammar or example that the same word works as a noun for the language (el inglés, as in ¿Hablas inglés?), which is probably the most common use in subtitles; a learner who answers "el inglés" has still recalled the right word.
